reels.title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion

editorial_notes.reasoning: High retention potential due to 2.0x multiplier for multimodal/diffusion; visually explains video generation which is highly engaging for casual viewers.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do AI videos stutter when they get too long, and how can we stop them?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A relay race where each runner holds a 'memory snapshot' (the KV cache) to ensure the next runner doesn't forget the story so far.
